landing.faq.stack.question: What's the tech stack?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Next.js 16 with the App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM, and better-auth. Every piece of business logic is inlined — no external packages for payment, email, storage, or AI.
landing.faq.payment.question: Which payment providers are supported?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Stripe, PayPal, Creem, Alipay, and WeChat Pay out of the box. The PaymentManager abstraction makes it straightforward to add more providers by implementing a single interface.
landing.faq.database.question: Which databases can I use?
landing.faq.database.answer: Drizzle ORM handles PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Turso, and Cloudflare D1. Switch providers by editing DATABASE_PROVIDER in your .env — the schema templates and drizzle config adapt automatically.
landing.faq.customize.question: How customizable is the landing page?
landing.faq.customize.answer: The src/blocks/ directory ships with demo sections — they're designed to be rewritten per project. The durable primitives live in src/components/, so your rebrand touches blocks and translations, not the chassis.
landing.faq.license.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
landing.faq.license.answer: Yes. ShipAny Next is built for shipping production SaaS products. You own the code after cloning — no per-seat fees, no runtime dependencies on our infrastructure.

hotel.how.title: How to Make a Hotel Lobby AI Video Free
hotel.how.one.title: Pick two clear portraits
hotel.how.one.text: Choose one clear photo for each adult performer. A visible face, natural expression and similar camera angle give the video model a stronger reference for keeping two people distinct.
hotel.how.two.title: Set the timing
hotel.how.two.text: Write a simple sequence: person A begins, person B reacts, then the lead changes. A fixed camera and small gestures usually make the first attempt easier to judge.
hotel.how.three.title: Generate and review
hotel.how.three.text: Press Generate. We first compose both people into the orange booth, then transfer the Hotel Lobby performance onto them. Review identity, hands, the center microphone and left-right placement before you share.
hotel.ideas.title: Same stage, different chemistry
hotel.ideas.description: The duet works best when the relationship between the two performers is easy to understand. Start with one moment, one camera angle and a clear handoff.
hotel.ideas.friends.title: Friends on the mic
hotel.ideas.friends.text: Make a call and response: one friend takes the first line, the other answers at the mic. Use eye contact, smiles and small gestures to show their connection.
hotel.ideas.siblings.title: Sibling back and forth
hotel.ideas.siblings.text: One sibling starts confidently; the other joins on the next beat. Keep them on opposite sides of the orange booth and let their expressions tell the story.
hotel.ideas.couples.title: Couples in sync
hotel.ideas.couples.text: Give a couple a quiet first verse and a shared chorus. Keep the gestures small and let a glance across the microphone mark the moment they come together.
hotel.bottom.title: The mic is waiting.
hotel.bottom.text: Choose your two performers and make the lobby scene your own.
hotel.footer.line: Create a two-person AI duet video with Hotel Lobby AI.

hotel.explainer.title: What is the Hotel Lobby AI filter?
hotel.explainer.one: Two subjects stand on opposite sides of one hanging microphone while the camera holds steady. One leads, the other reacts, and then they trade the moment. Friends, partners or family members can appear together even when their source photos were taken separately.
hotel.explainer.two: This page makes that look for you. Choose two portraits, decide who appears on each side and optionally add a styling note. We compose the scene with GPT Image 2 and animate it with DreamActor motion transfer, which carries over the reference performance and its audio.
hotel.explainer.three: Think of it as a short scene. A good result keeps each person recognizable, gives both people room and places the microphone between them. Orange walls, warm light and a steady camera unify the setup. Results vary with the model and photos, so review the clip before posting.
hotel.guide.title: Make your Hotel Lobby AI duet look more like your people
hotel.guide.intro: A precise prompt helps, but the photos you choose set the ceiling for the final scene. These checks can reduce common identity and composition problems before you generate.
hotel.guide.photos.title: Start with useful portraits
hotel.guide.photos.text: Use sharp images with full faces and enough clothing to guide the scene. Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, crowded backgrounds and cropped faces. Similar lighting and perspective can make the duet feel more consistent. If one portrait is a close-up and the other shows a full body, crop or replace one so the references match more closely. Neutral expressions leave more room for a believable reaction. Only transform images you have permission to use.
hotel.guide.motion.title: Keep the action readable
hotel.guide.motion.text: Describe one short exchange: a lead singer, a listening reaction and a handoff. Ask for natural mouth movement and small gestures while the camera stays centered. State whose lips move in each beat so the performers do not appear to sing the same line at once. Fast turns and sudden cuts can make faces or left-right positions harder to preserve.
hotel.guide.review.title: Inspect the first take
hotel.guide.review.text: Watch the clip before sharing. Confirm that A stays left, B stays right and the microphone stays between them. Check for warped hands, merged faces, extra people or changing outfits. Watch once with the sound off: the handoff should still make visual sense. If a face changes midway, shorten the scene before adding more movement. If the scene breaks, simplify your direction and try again.
hotel.prompt.title: Write a prompt that keeps the duet in focus
hotel.prompt.one: For a Hotel Lobby AI duet, the starter prompt names the main visual anchors: a vertical 9:16 frame, a matte-orange booth, two separate people, one black microphone, soft light and a locked camera. It also asks the model to preserve faces and outfits and avoid side swaps, added people, captions and watermarks. These constraints give the generator a clearer shot list than a vague request to make two photos sing together.
hotel.prompt.two: Use the direction field for one styling detail, such as outfits, accessories or expressions. Keep it short so the core composition still leads — the booth, the center microphone and left-right placement are fixed by the base prompt. If the first result is off, change one thing at a time and generate again.
hotel.faq.title: Duet video FAQ
hotel.faq.one.question: Can I generate the duet video on this page?
hotel.faq.one.answer: Yes. Sign in, upload one photo for each side and press Generate. The scene is ready in under a minute and the finished video in about 3–5 minutes. Each video uses credits.
hotel.faq.two.question: What happens to my photos?
hotel.faq.two.answer: When you press Generate, your two photos are resized in your browser and sent to our AI provider (fal.ai) to create the scene and the video. They are not uploaded before you press Generate. Only use photos you have permission to use.
hotel.faq.three.question: Can I make the duet with two separate photos?
hotel.faq.three.answer: Yes. Use one clear reference for each adult, with A on the left and B on the right. Identity preservation depends on the generator and photos, so inspect the result.
hotel.faq.four.question: Why do the faces or positions change in my result?
hotel.faq.four.answer: Models can drift when references are unclear or actions are busy. Use visible faces, remove camera moves and describe a shorter exchange. Repeat left-right placement and request one continuous shot. A usable clip may take several tries.
hotel.faq.five.question: Can I use photos of a couple or friends?
hotel.faq.five.answer: Yes. The orange booth can frame a couple, friends or adult family members. Change the performance direction but keep identities separate. Get permission from everyone pictured and identify the result as AI-generated when sharing.
hotel.faq.six.question: How much does a Hotel Lobby AI video cost?
hotel.faq.six.answer: Planning and previewing are free. Generating a video uses credits; the exact amount is shown next to the Generate button and on the pricing section. Buy a one-time pack or subscribe monthly.
hotel.faq.seven.question: What is the hotel lobby AI trend?
hotel.faq.seven.answer: It is a two-person duet scene in an orange recording booth. One person starts a line beside a hanging microphone, and the other responds. Creators often use two separate photos to plan a shared AI video scene.
hotel.faq.eight.question: Can I still use Dreamina or another tool?
hotel.faq.eight.answer: Yes. The look is tool-agnostic: any image-to-video tool that accepts two reference photos and a vertical 9:16 clip can recreate it. Generating here just saves you the manual steps.

landing.about.title: What is Genjutsu AI?
landing.about.p1: Genjutsu AI is an online AI video generator and AI image generator built for people who publish every day. The name comes from the Japanese word for an illusion technique: a scene that feels real but begins as an idea. That is the whole product. You describe what the camera should see, we send your prompt to a leading model, track the render, and hand back an MP4 or image you can post right away.
landing.about.p2: Most AI tools make you choose between quality and speed, or between one model and another, each with its own subscription. This studio puts Seedance Pro, Seedance Lite and GPT Image 2 behind a single credit balance. Draft a scene on a fast, low-cost model, then re-render the take you like in cinematic 1080p, without leaving the page or opening another account.
landing.about.p3: Every render is priced in credits, and you see the cost before you click Generate. If a generation fails, the credits come back automatically, so experimenting never feels like a gamble.

landing.faq.prompt.question: How do I write a good prompt?
landing.faq.prompt.answer: Name the subject, the action, the setting and the light, then add one camera instruction such as a slow dolly-in or a handheld close-up. Short, concrete prompts usually beat long lists of adjectives.

landing.guide.title: Genjutsu AI vs Higgsfield Genjutsu
landing.guide.p1: Many people searching for genjutsu are looking for Higgsfield Genjutsu, a video-to-video tool Higgsfield released in September 2026. It rebuilds a clip you already have. Motion Transfer keeps the acting, lip sync and camera movement while swapping in a new character, location or look. Object Swap replaces a single element, such as an outfit or a product, and leaves the rest of the shot untouched. It accepts source videos of 3 to 30 seconds and outputs up to 1080p.
landing.guide.p2: This site is an independent studio and is not affiliated with Higgsfield. Instead of editing footage you upload, it creates new footage from a written prompt. If you need to recast a clip you already shot, Higgsfield's tool is made for that. If you have an idea but no footage, start here: describe the shot and get a finished clip back.

landing.tutorial.iterate.title: Iterate, then post
landing.tutorial.iterate.description: Change one detail per take, keep the version that works, and download the MP4 for TikTok, Reels, Shorts or an ad.
landing.tutorial.note: Following a Higgsfield Genjutsu tutorial instead? That workflow is different: upload a 3 to 30 second clip, add images of the character or product, choose Motion Transfer or Object Swap, then render. It edits existing footage, while the steps above create footage from scratch.
landing.effects.title: Change outfits, weather and scenes with a word
landing.effects.description: Every clip starts from text, so restyling a scene means editing a phrase, not masking frames. Keep the subject and camera line the same and swap one detail per take.
landing.compare.title: Genjutsu vs Seedance: which fits your shot?
landing.compare.description: They solve different problems. Higgsfield Genjutsu transforms a video you already have. Seedance, which powers the video side of this studio, creates a new clip from a written prompt.
landing.compare.input.label: Starting point
landing.compare.input.genjutsu: An existing 3 to 30 s video plus reference images
landing.compare.input.seedance: A text prompt, no footage needed
landing.compare.control.label: What you change
landing.compare.control.genjutsu: Who or what appears, while motion and camera stay locked
landing.compare.control.seedance: Subject, setting, light, style and camera move
landing.compare.length.label: Clip length
landing.compare.resolution.label: Resolution
landing.compare.cost.label: Typical cost
landing.compare.cost.genjutsu: About $2 (480p) to $7.20 (1080p) per 15 s clip, as reported at launch
landing.compare.best.label: Best for
landing.compare.best.genjutsu: Recasting footage, product and outfit swaps
landing.compare.best.seedance: New ideas, B-roll, ads and shorts with no filming
landing.compare.footnote: Higgsfield details come from its launch materials and may change. Check higgsfield.ai for current pricing.
landing.free.title: Is Genjutsu AI free?
landing.free.p1: Creating an account, browsing the prompt library and opening any example in the studio cost nothing. Rendering uses credits, because every clip runs on paid GPU time at the model provider. There is no free plan, but there is no subscription requirement either: the smallest one-time pack is $5 for 440 credits, enough for three 5 second 720p videos. Credits from a failed render come back automatically, and the exact price is shown before you press Generate.
landing.free.p2: Arrived from a search for a free Higgsfield Genjutsu trial? Higgsfield offered free tries of its own tool at launch; those limits are set on higgsfield.ai, not here.
landing.faq.higgsfield.question: Is this the Higgsfield Genjutsu tool?
landing.faq.higgsfield.answer: No. This is an independent text-to-video and image studio with no affiliation to Higgsfield. Higgsfield Genjutsu edits a video you upload; this site creates new videos and images from a prompt.
landing.faq.free.question: Can I try it for free?
landing.faq.free.answer: Signing up and exploring the studio is free, but each render costs credits. Packs start at $5 with no subscription, and failed renders are refunded automatically.

admin.indexnow.title: IndexNow
admin.indexnow.description: Tell Bing, Yandex and other IndexNow search engines about new or changed pages right away instead of waiting for their crawlers.
admin.indexnow.step_key_desc: Paste the key generated in Bing Webmaster Tools →
admin.indexnow.step_verify_desc: The site serves the key at /your-key.txt automatically — search engines read it to confirm you own the site.
admin.indexnow.key_file_bad: Not reachable yet (HTTP {status}). If you just saved, wait a minute and re-check.
admin.indexnow.step_submit_desc: Submit every page in sitemap.xml, or paste specific URLs (one per line). Resubmit only when pages change.
